scope: Uniform positivity and a positive-axis normal inverse for the separated curvature-free form; actual charged retarded reduction remains open

primary_sources.reading_scope: Corollary 2, equation (10), page 3: logarithmic uncertainty with n=1 and p=2.
primary_sources.use: Established full-line logarithmic inequality. Positive frequency potentials preserve the operator comparison used here; this does not identify the scalar model with the Dirac determinant.
primary_sources.reuse_scope: Previously read Corollary 2, equation (10), with n=1,p=2. The present bound adds elementary weighted Hardy and positive-resolvent arguments; no new uncertainty principle is claimed.

closest_comparator: The preceding outer scalar separation proved curvature-free positivity only at zero scaled frequency. The present uniform two-sided estimate of E_kappa-2P extends it to all real scaled frequencies and supplies a closed positive normal realization for kappa>0. It does not establish a charged causal inverse or remove the fast scalar branch.
